subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

In a nutshell
solution:
The correct answer is **"Briefly"**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Let's learn the meaning of this idiom:

__
 
• **In a nutshell (*idiom) -* **In summary; concisely.

 
 
• ***Eg.*** *In a nutshell*, the app helps you to plan parties.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will see the other idioms:

 
• **In a bad spot *(idiom)* - **In a challenging or problematic situation; in a predicament.

 
 
• ***Eg. ***I'm* in a bad spot *here—I need to be at a job interview in an hour, and my car won't start.
